[Your Turn] When effects place [Vemmon] as any of your Digimon's digivolution cards, [Delay].
• 1 of your Digimon with [Vemmon] in its text may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Vemmon] in its text in the hand or trash with the cost reduced by 3.
